title: The Pen is Mightier Than the Keyboard

lines.text: Surprisingly, typing notes on a laptop can be less effective than writing them by hand.
Researchers found that laptop users took more notes but performed worse on tests.
They transcribed lectures verbatim rather than processing the information.
This shallow processing leads to poorer understanding and recall.
Even when laptops are used solely for note taking, they can impair learning.

sources: Mueller PA, Oppenheimer DM (2014). The pen is mightier than the keyboard. Psychol Sci 25(6):1159-1168. PMID 24760141
